meta.source_policy: Official Blizzard hero pages and patch notes take precedence; current granular mechanics use reviewed community references when Blizzard does not publish numeric detail.
meta.editorial_method: Per-hero mechanics review. Matchups are interaction notes, not live win-rate counter rankings. Crosshairs are starting points, not objective best settings.
meta.current_patch_status: No October 2026 live patch notes published as of 2026-10-06; September 22 is the latest live update and September 17 is the latest balance patch.
meta.damage_output_fix_note: Hero cards now surface damage/healing output explicitly; Junkrat Total Mayhem corrected to numeric current mechanics.
meta.hero_snapshot_note: Compact hero snapshots derive numeric rows from current verified mechanics; playstyle/aim/difficulty/strengths/weaknesses are reviewed editorial guidance.
meta.damage_breakdown_note: Visual damage/healing breakdowns derive per-instance, full-shot/full-burst, crit, and theoretical totals from verified mechanics when the data model supports safe arithmetic.
meta.guided_hero_layout_note: Hero pages default to a problem-first questionnaire; full database reference is collapsed until requested.
meta.kill_calculator_note: Pattern-based TTK calculator accounts for verified hit damage, headshots, falloff, projectile travel, armor, DoT, charge levels, optional boosts/reductions, and ability/melee sequences where the current data model supports safe arithmetic.
meta.breakpoint_note: Hero breakpoint views derive body/headshot counts and deterministic ability-openers from the same verified combat model used by the Kill Calculator; specific-target results apply current target armor and selected range.
meta.aim_guide_note: Dedicated per-hero aim guides include aim type, where to aim, preferred range, vertical placement, movement interaction cues, mechanics cues, drills, and a reviewed crosshair starting point.
meta.patch_impact_note: Patch dashboard interprets numeric balance changes, shows percentage deltas and safe derived changes, and explicitly notes that snapshots, breakpoints and kill-calculator math read current combat values.
meta.trust_strip_note: Hero headers show the latest official patch check, the latest recorded balance change for that hero, the latest reviewed editorial date, and whether the latest live patch contains balance changes.

guide.gameplan: Maintain team sustain from cover while contributing meaningful damage or debuffs whenever healing demand is low. Heal from long cover, use Biotic Grenade to create anti-heal or amplified-heal windows, and reserve Sleep Dart for important dives/channels when needed.
guide.positioning: Back-midrange sightline with cover and a rotation route.
guide.engagement: Enable the team by pressuring the same target or applying utility before the engage.
guide.ability_usage: Save at least one high-impact defensive utility for enemy burst/dives. Current kit priorities include Sleep Dart, Biotic Grenade, Nano Boost; use the hero page’s verified cooldown/range data to judge when those tools are actually available.
guide.ultimate_usage: Use the ultimate proactively while allies are still able to act. For Ana, review Nano Boost against enemy immunity, mobility, and line-of-sight before committing it.
guide.survival: Rotate before divers arrive and do not hard-scope/charge so long that flank awareness disappears.

Using several abilities at once when one would solve the problem
Focusing the nearest tank while a higher-value target is exposed

aimGuide.where_to_aim: Scoped shots are hitscan, so place the crosshair directly on the target. Unscoped shots are projectile, so lead moving targets. Decide which mode you are using before the shot instead of aiming halfway between both models.

drills: At 15 m, heal/damage stationary targets unscoped and learn the projectile travel feel.
At 20 m, alternate scoped hitscan shots and unscoped projectile shots on a strafing target.

Practice Sleep Dart on predictable movement: jump arcs, doorways, and enemies moving straight at you.
Finish with scoped shot → unscoped shot → Biotic Grenade target swap so changing aim modes does not break crosshair discipline.
mechanics_cues: Projectile speed: 125 m/s unscoped; hitscan scoped

aimGuide.where_to_aim: Aim where the target is moving, not where they are now. With Zhuque Fans, keep the crosshair slightly ahead of a strafe and increase the lead as distance grows.
aimGuide.vertical_aiming: Hold the crosshair around upper-chest to head height before the target appears. Against jumping or airborne targets, move the crosshair to the landing/flight path instead of chasing the model after it moves.
drills: At 15 m, hit a strafing bot with Zhuque Fans without moving your own character.
Move to 25 m and exaggerate the lead until you can see how travel time changes the shot.
Alternate one upper-chest attempt and one head-height attempt so you learn both safe and high-value aim.
Add your own left-right strafe while keeping the lead smooth instead of correcting after every miss.
Finish with 10 repetitions of your normal engage or setup into Zhuque Fans, then reset immediately after each attempt.

guide.gameplan: Maintain team sustain from cover while contributing meaningful damage or debuffs whenever healing demand is low. Harmony an active ally, Discord the target your team can actually shoot, and use Orb volleys to punish predictable peeks while staying protected from dive.
guide.positioning: Back-midrange sightline with cover and a rotation route.
guide.engagement: Enable the team by pressuring the same target or applying utility before the engage.
guide.ability_usage: Save at least one high-impact defensive utility for enemy burst/dives. Current kit priorities include Harmony Orb, Orb of Harmony, Orb of Discord, Transcendence; use the hero page’s verified cooldown/range data to judge when those tools are actually available.
guide.ultimate_usage: Use the ultimate proactively while allies are still able to act. For Zenyatta, review Transcendence against enemy immunity, mobility, and line-of-sight before committing it.
guide.survival: Rotate before divers arrive and do not hard-scope/charge so long that flank awareness disappears.
common_mistakes: Fighting outside Zenyatta’s preferred range or geometry
Spending the main escape/defensive cooldown before enemy pressure arrives
Using several abilities at once when one would solve the problem
Focusing the nearest tank while a higher-value target is exposed
quick_tips: Harmony an active ally, Discord the target your team can actually shoot, and use Orb volleys to punish predictable peeks while staying protected from dive.
Use natural cover between cooldown cycles.
Track enemy movement/defensive cooldowns before the commit.
Enter when teammates can pressure at the same time.
Review recent patch changes on this page before relying on old damage/cooldown memory.

aimGuide.where_to_aim: Aim where the target is moving, not where they are now. With Orb of Destruction, keep the crosshair slightly ahead of a strafe and increase the lead as distance grows.
aimGuide.vertical_aiming: Hold the crosshair around upper-chest to head height before the target appears. Against jumping or airborne targets, move the crosshair to the landing/flight path instead of chasing the model after it moves.
drills: At 15 m, hit a strafing bot with Orb of Destruction without moving your own character.
Move to 25 m and exaggerate the lead until you can see how travel time changes the shot.
Alternate one upper-chest attempt and one head-height attempt so you learn both safe and high-value aim.
Add your own left-right strafe while keeping the lead smooth instead of correcting after every miss.
Finish with 10 repetitions of your normal engage or setup into Orb of Destruction, then reset immediately after each attempt.
mechanics_cues: Fire rate: 2.5 primary; charged volley cadence/s
